name: 红尘 (in-game: 红尘录)
group_note: ES II lineage, standalone; from 2026-07-29 bulk mudlib.rar drop. Native boot was already verified in an earlier pass (see NOTES.md); this WASM pass fixed two WASM-specific gaps the native driver doesn't hit: (1) include/restart.h was genuinely empty (0 bytes) in both the raw archive and converted source -- a pre-existing incomplete-source bug, not a conversion artifact -- leaving adm/daemons/restartd.lpc's SHUTDOWN/REBOOT/HALT/CALLOUT_INTERVAL/RESTART_INTERVAL undefined; reconstructed all six constants from the daemon's own usage (restartd.lpc is preloaded but non-critical, so this was previously masked at boot). (2) adm/daemons/logind.lpc's very first per-connection message used socket_address(ob) (sockets-package efun, undefined on this driver) to extract the connecting port; switched to query_ip_port(ob), a real efun already used elsewhere in the codebase. Also upgraded the admin wizlist entry from the previously-seeded 'fluffos (admin)' to 'fluffos (boss)' -- this lineage's wiz_levels ranks (boss) above (admin) as the true top tier, and (boss) is confirmed present in securityd.lpc's trusted_read/trusted_write['/'] tables. Full registration (id->confirm->Chinese name->password->confirm->gift roll->email->gender) -> enter world -> look -> score -> quit verified working, admin id 'fluffos' shows (boss) and update succeeded pre-formatter. LPC formatter run across all 10328 files; reverted 2 files with confirmed stray-corruption (cmds/adm/hbless.lpc, d/city/diaoyuchi1.h -- both had the classic \ n / unquoted-CJK-string corruption from already-unbalanced quotes) and 1 file with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (d/player/fyue_room.lpc), found via a same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across all 112 files the formatter touched with CJK-space-CJK sequences -- the other 109 were pre-existing author spacing, unchanged by the diff. Post-formatter re-verified: clean boot, zero compile errors, registration and (boss) permission display both still correct.
